description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories are labeled as "chat" (red, 41.2%), "math" (blue, 21.9%), "tooluse" (green, 11.6%), "multi turn chat" (orange, 9.3%), "code" (purple, 9.0%), and "instruction follow" (pink, 6.9%). The percentage values are displayed next to each slice. A legend is provided in the top-left corner, listing the categories and their corresponding colors, along with numerical values for each category. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with "chat" being the largest and "instruction follow" being the smallest. No slices are visually emphasized or offset.
